shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone slab
human or humanoid figure in profile
band of small repeated signs or motifs in a row
justification: Both surfaces are flat slabs organised into horizontal registers, with rows of small repeated signs above and larger profile figures (including bird-like long-beaked creatures and a humanoid) below, which gives a loose arrangement correspondence. But A is a dense inscriptional field of tiny standardised script signs with small seated/kneeling worshipper-like figures facing offering tables, while B has a few large, boldly modelled sculptural animals (a crouching quadruped, snake-like and bird forms) and three big rounded shapes across the top with no writing — the conventions of depiction and the specific motifs are quite different.
